summary: This clinical trial is testing a drug called tirzepatide compared to a placebo, which is an inactive substance, in children ages 6 to less than 12 who have obesity. The study looks at how body mass index, a measure of body fat based on height and weight, changes over time. Eli Lilly and Company is the sponsor for this Phase 3 study, which has an enrollment of 150 participants and is currently Recruiting.
